title: Add Owner, Owned, Edge, and Connection to Every Entity
description: Add union XOwner, union XOwned, type XEdge implements EntityEdge, and type XConnection implements EntityConnection for every entity type in compose/graphql/target.schema.graphql. Also make Side implement Entity, make Diffs an interface, add missing PieceModification type, fix the EntityConnection union/interface conflict, and update owner/owns fields to use typed versions.
summary: Relay-aligned EntityEdge now declares only cursor (like ShipEdge without abstract node). Every concrete Edge type exposes node as its paired concrete entity type (e.g. VectorEdge.node: Vector!, BridgeEdge.node: Connection!, PointDiffEdge.node: PositionDiff!), not Entity!. Resolved GraphQL SDL name clash by renaming the polymorphic union to AnyEntityConnection for owns/removed/added while keeping interface EntityConnection for concrete Connection implementations. Removed unused empty enum ConflictKind that broke SDL parsing. Verified graphql-core parse and compose crate parses_target_schema / cargo tests.
